mappings.note: Asks for the भाव of the line 'बिरह भुवंगम तन बसै'. Explaining the भाव-पक्ष of a couplet is LO-5; LO-4 is cited for factual comprehension questions, which this is not.
Who failed to become ज्ञानी: the पंडित who only read books. That is Kabir's social criticism of bookish, outward learning, LO-4 under C-H2.1, not a plain comprehension item.
How the lamp of knowledge dispels darkness: a काव्यबोध comprehension question on the prescribed saakhi. Not LO-5, since no भाव or अलंकार is to be expounded.
Who Kabir calls सुखी: direct comprehension of the 'सुखिया सब संसार है' saakhi, LO-4.
Kabir's advice for keeping one's nature pure (निंदक नियरे राखिए): comprehension of the saakhi's counsel, LO-4.

Kabir's date and place of birth. Poet biography, which no LO in this frame covers: C-H2.1-LO-3 asks why his AGE was revolutionary, not when he was born. Competency-level citation under the literature competency.
The main purpose of the saakhis, which is moral instruction through criticism of hypocrisy and outward ritual: LO-4's आडंबर-विरोध. Not LO-5, which is about भाव and कला.
Which languages colour Kabir's saakhis: the कला-पक्ष (diction and language) half of LO-5, not the भाव half and not comprehension.
Meaning of 'साक्ष्य': a word-meaning question arising from the text, so काव्यबोध under LO-4. The तत्सम/तद्भव form is asked separately at qid:104107 and takes the grammar competency.
तत्सम/तद्भव word-formation. This is a व्याकरण item, so the language competency C-H2.2, not a literature outcome.
What kind of light the poet wishes to spread: comprehension of the दीपक saakhi, LO-4.
The अलंकार in 'पोथी पढ़ि-पढ़ि' (पुनरुक्ति): a कला-पक्ष question, LO-5. Not LO-4, which covers the sense rather than the device.
Meaning of 'अषिर': word-meaning comprehension within the prescribed poem, LO-4.
What Ram and kasturi have in common: comprehension of the कस्तूरी saakhi's comparison, LO-4. LO-5 would fit an item naming the device rather than drawing the sense.
Meaning of 'कुंडलि': word-meaning comprehension, LO-4.
The condition of the बिरही: comprehension of the विरह saakhi. Contrast qid:104098, which asks for the भाव of the line itself and so takes LO-5.
The आशय of 'जिवै तो बौरा होइ': expounding the sense of a line is भाव-पक्ष व्याख्या, LO-5.
The अलंकार in 'सुखिया सब संसार है' (अनुप्रास): कला-पक्ष, LO-5, as with qid:104109.
Why the whole world is said to be happy: comprehension of the saakhi's claim, LO-4.
The तात्पर्य of 'मन का आपा खोने': expounding a phrase's sense, so भाव-पक्ष व्याख्या, LO-5.
The effect of sweet speech on others: comprehension of the मीठी वाणी saakhi, LO-4.
तद्भव form of 'साखी': word-formation, the grammar competency, as with qid:104107.
What a साखी is, as a form. This is genre knowledge, which is C-H2.3's 'विविध विधाओं का बोध'; neither LO-4 nor LO-5 asks the candidate to define the form.
Who Kabir's guru was: poet biography, cited at competency level for the same reason as qid:104103.
Meaning of 'मिट्टी' as used in the saakhi: word-meaning comprehension, LO-4.
Who Kabir calls दुखी: the counterpart of qid:104101 in the same saakhi, so the same comprehension outcome.

Why we fail to see the God who pervades everything: Kabir's charge that we search outside instead of within, which is his critique of outward ritual, LO-4 under C-H2.1. Not LO-4 of the poetry set, since the item turns on the social-religious criticism rather than the line's plain sense.
पदबंध भेद: a व्याकरण item embedded in a literature chapter, so the language competency C-H2.2 rather than any काव्य outcome. Defect: the underlining that marks the phrase is lost in the loaded text.
पदबंध भेद, grammar competency. The instruction is duplicated in the stem ('रेखांकित पदों का पदबंध भेद बतायें' twice) and the underlining is again absent.

पदबंध भेद. Defect: the instruction line is missing entirely from this stem, leaving only the sentence; it is mapped because its place in the run of qid:104125 to qid:104129 makes the task unambiguous.
